links.comparator_used: Variant 1: unstructured, open-ended request to ChatGPT, compared with structured data entry with predefined emission factors (Variants 2 and 3); estimates benchmarked against the Excel tool
links.outcome: Accuracy and specificity of carbon footprint estimates and recommendations
links.effect: No numeric effect reported. Unstructured prompts gave general recommendations of limited contextual relevance. Structured prompts improved accuracy and specificity. Estimates were largely comparable to the Excel benchmark, with minor discrepancies in waste-related emissions.
links.tradeoff: Risk of hallucinated outputs and regional generalisations. Effective use requires prompt literacy and open access to validated emission factor databases. Minor discrepancies in waste-related emissions.
links.quote: Structured prompts improved both accuracy and specificity.

links.comparator_used: Variants 1 and 2 (unstructured prompt, or structured prompt with emission factors only) versus Variant 3, which instructed ChatGPT to rely exclusively on outputs from a previously validated sustainability tool
links.outcome: Quality and evidence base of sustainability recommendations, and agreement of footprint estimates with the Excel benchmark
links.effect: No numeric effect reported. Variant 3 gave detailed, evidence-based recommendations consistent with established literature. Estimates were largely comparable to the Excel benchmark across variants, with minor discrepancies in waste-related emissions.
links.tradeoff: Risk of hallucinations and regional generalisations remains. Needs access to validated emission factor databases and prompt literacy.
links.quote: Variant 2 generated tailored outputs using emission factors, while Variant 3 provided detailed, evidence-based recommendations consistent with established literature.

design_hint: structured prompting with grounding in a validated tool
